               Table "public.room_names"
  Column  |   Type    | Collation | Nullable | Default 
----------+-----------+-----------+----------+---------
 id       | integer   |           |          | 
 valid_at | daterange |           |          | 
 name     | text      |           |          | 
Indexes:
    "room_names_uq" UNIQUE (id, valid_at WITHOUT OVERLAPS) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
Foreign-key constraints:
    "room_names_fk" FOREIGN KEY (id, PERIOD valid_at) REFERENCES rooms(id, PERIOD valid_at)
